Composition & Indication

Tamsulosin 0.4mg — 30 Capsules (Generic for Flomax®) contains Tamsulosin Hydrochloride 0.4 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Capsules at the official 0.4mg strength. The standard indication is the management of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Tamsulosin 0.4mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use.
